card.name: Gap right before a number
card.fires_on: The separator just before a numeric value: a space after a comma in confidence intervals, a decimal point inside table numbers, or a dollar sign before a price. It fires in the spot where the next digits begin.

modes.label: Space before second number
modes.description: A space after a comma or before a number in a range or interval.

modes.label: Decimal point in tables
modes.description: The decimal point inside a number in a table row of means and SDs.

modes.label: Currency sign
modes.description: A dollar sign right before an amount.
